article_name: ABA’s Treasury check verification tool allows banks to report counterfeit checks
raw_content: Banks using the American Banker Associationsonline tool to access the Treasury Check Verification Systemwill be able to report counterfeit checks through the tool starting Wednesday, according to Paul Benda, ABA EVP for Risk, Fraud and Cybersecurity.Benda announced the new feature at theFinancial Crimes Enforcement Conference, which is taking place this week in Arlington, Virginia. ABA launched the tool in June, allowing member banks to access the Treasury Departments TCVS at no cost. Since then, the tool has processed more than $600 million in Treasury checks.The new reporting system will allow ABA to collect real-time information on counterfeiting, Benda said.Were not tracking it by bank. Were not tracking it by payee names. Were not capturing any information like that, he said. Were simply capturing the fact that this is occurring.Tags:ABA newscheck fraudFraudScams
